notes.title: Added interesting new game mechanics
notes.content:
Soldiers are [b]now required to transport the collected resources to the castle[/b], which brings huge and interesting changes to the game.

When the health of your castle drops below half for the first time, you will [b]receive a large amount of resource support and send a hero 10 levels higher than the castle to fight[/b].
Modified some maps.
Minor changes to some values.
